item.text:
**Summary**  
Mixed, leaning negative. Jokowi did maintain some technocratic and rule-based channels, but 2024 shows repeated favoritism signals in appointments, succession politics, procurement, and information control.

**Evidence**
- `[Trenches: Sri Mulyani, the relentless reformer](https://www.imf.org/en/publications/fandd/issues/2024/12/trenches-relentless-reformer-sri-mulyani-indrawati)` | IMF | 2024-12 | Jokowi retained Sri Mulyani, a highly regarded reform-minded finance minister who strengthened macro foundations and enforced high standards. This is the best positive appointment evidence against pure patronage. | `7B.9` `7B.8`
- `[Indonesia’s anti-graft body plans to query president’s son about private jet trip](https://www.arabnews.com/node/2569216/world)` | Reuters via Arab News | 2024-08-28 | The anti-graft body publicly moved to question Kaesang Pangarep about a private jet trip and possible improper gifts. That shows scrutiny of a close family associate was not blocked outright. | `7B.9` `7B.6` `7B.7`
- `[Indonesia’s anti-graft body plans to query president’s son about private jet trip](https://www.arabnews.com/node/2569216/world)` | Reuters via Arab News | 2024-08-28 | The same episode also shows why the public saw office-adjacent benefit as plausible, so it is only a limited positive. | `7B.9`
- `[Indonesia’s outgoing leader gives cabinet jobs to loyalists of successor Prabowo](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/outgoing-indonesian-president-widodo-names-prabowo-aides-to-cabinet-3576652)` | Reuters | 2024-08-19 | Jokowi appointed ministers with close ties to Prabowo to smooth the transition. Reuters framed this as loyalty-heavy political management rather than clean merit selection. | `7B.9` `7B.8`
- `[Indonesia’s Golkar party picks influential Jokowi’s top loyalist as leader](https://theprint.in/world/indonesias-golkar-party-picks-influential-jokowis-top-loyalist-as-leader/2231679/)` | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-08-21 | Golkar chose a Jokowi loyalist as leader, and the reporting says Jokowi sought to preserve influence after office. This is direct evidence of patronage and network control. | `7B.9` `7B.8`
- `[Analysis - Indonesia’s Jokowi seeks major party takeover to retain decade-long influence](https://whbl.com/2024/03/20/analysis-indonesias-jokowi-seeks-major-party-takeover-to-retain-decade-long-influence/)` | Reuters via WHBL | 2024-03-20 | Reuters reported Jokowi was trying to install a key ally at Golkar and use the party as a post-office political vehicle. That is strong negative evidence for avoiding transactional politics. | `7B.9` `7B.8`
- `[Indonesia shelves plan to revise election law as protests rage](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/protests-across-indonesia-as-parliament-delays-change-to-election-law-3582501)` | Reuters | 2024-08-22 | Planned election-law changes were widely seen as benefiting Jokowi’s youngest son and consolidating family advantage. That is one of the clearest nepotism signals in 2024. | `7B.9` `4B.2` `7B.8`
- `[Indonesia president says he respects institutions amid power struggle over court ruling](https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-president-says-he-respects-institutions-amid-power-struggle-over-court-ruling/2232362/)` | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-08-21 | Jokowi publicly said he respected institutional decisions while allies moved to reverse a court ruling affecting regional elections. The public line was restraint, but the surrounding politics were not clean. | `7B.9` `7B.8`
- `[Indonesia leader accused of bias, interference in presidential election](https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-leader-accused-of-bias-interference-in-presidential-election/1948656/)` | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-02-01 | Reuters reported criticism that Jokowi’s public alignment with Prabowo, while his son was on the ticket, looked like incumbent power being turned into family political advantage. | `7B.9` `4B.2` `7B.8`
- `[Indonesia court rejects election disputes, upholding president-elect Prabowo’s win](https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-court-rejects-election-disputes-upholding-president-elect-prabowos-win/2051390/)` | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-04-22 | The court said there was no evidence of systematic fraud or presidential meddling. That is limited positive evidence that the formal process was allowed to stand. | `7B.9` `7B.8`
- `[World Bank Group Debars PT. LPPSLH Konsultan](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/07/10/world-bank-group-debars-pt-lppslh-konsultan)` | World Bank | 2024-07-10 | The World Bank said a Jokowi-era nutrition project involved overbilling and improperly hiring a project official’s family member. This is concrete procurement favoritism, even if not a direct personal order from Jokowi. | `7B.9` `7B.7`
- `[Indonesia: Freedom on the Net 2024 Country Report](https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-net/2024)` | Freedom House | 2024 | Freedom House says Kominfo could directly restrict content without appeals, critics and journalists faced prosecution and harassment, and disinformation and self-censorship were widespread. This is strong negative evidence on access to public information and state information control. | `7B.9` `7B.7` `7B.8`
- `[Indonesia: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report](https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-world/2024)` | Freedom House | 2024 | The press environment remained constrained, and journalists covering corruption and other sensitive topics faced harassment and threats. That undercuts any claim of a clean anti-clientelist information environment. | `7B.9` `7B.7` `7B.6`
- `[Indonesia’s end-of-term analysis says Jokowi left patronage, dynastic politics, and weaker institutional integrity](https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/)` | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-10-14 | Reuters’ year-end analysis is the broadest negative summary: patronage and dynastic politics became defining features of the decade. It strongly supports a negative 7B.9 reading. | `7B.9` `7B.8` `7B.6`
- `[Ombudsman RI Kritik Dugaan Larangan Jilbab Anggota Paskibraka 2024](https://ombudsman.go.id/news/r/ombudsman-ri-kritik-dugaan-larangan-jilbab-anggota-paskibraka-2024)` | Ombudsman RI | 2024-08-15 | The Ombudsman said the Paskibraka hijab instruction left participants no real choice and should be treated as discriminatory. This is a negative signal on impartial treatment and state neutrality in access to public roles. | `7B.9` `7B.8`

**Search gap**
- I did not find a 2024 case of a named pardon/clemency decision that clearly showed favoritism or its absence.
- I also did not find a direct, documentable Jokowi-issued procurement award personally traced to him. The strongest procurement evidence is the World Bank debarment in a Jokowi-era project and the broader patronage pattern around appointments and electoral rules.
- Overall, the evidence is strongest on appointments, succession politics, and information control, weaker on pardons specifically.
